I grew up in a time in America where any Korean dude was a Chinaman

any Vietnaemse dude was a Chinaman

and two white guys killed Vincent Chin for being Japanese

getting 3 years probation and a fine of about 1.1 ETH

(or 0.035 btc, if you prefer)

now, when accurate identification/translation is owly somewhere between half a second and 5 keystrokes away

it's still easier to say I don't know

say yes 2 this magical power to just know

say no 2 micro-aggressions
